name: scroll-carousel
title: Scroll Carousel
description: A 3D ring of pictures that turns as you scroll, driven by a CSS scroll timeline, with a scroll-listener fallback and a flat strip under reduced motion.
label: Scroll carousel
author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>

props.name: images
props.description: The pictures on the ring, in order; 3 or more (the pen used 10 to 50). Every picture needs alt text.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the scroll region.

props.name: scrollDriven
props.description: Turn the ring with the scroller (the pen's Scroll Drive). Off, it turns by itself (half a second per picture for each turn).

props.name: animate
props.description: Off, the ring stands still and there is nothing to scroll.

props.name: vertical / infinite
props.description: Scroll up and down instead of across; wrap around at either end.

props.name: ratio / gap
props.description: Scroll distance per picture, and the space between pictures, both as a multiple of the picture width.

props.name: perspective / rotateX / rotateZ
props.description: Perspective in px, and the ring's tilt and roll in degrees.

props.name: maskLower / maskUpper
props.description: Where the edge fade is fully opaque and fully transparent, in picture widths from the centre.

props.name: backface
props.description: Show the back of the pictures on the far side of the ring.

props.name: scheme
props.description: The color scheme of the system colors it draws with; auto inherits.

props.name: hint
props.description: The word in the corner while the ring is scroll-driven; null hides it.

props.name: scrollDriver
props.description: auto: a CSS scroll timeline where supported, a scroll listener elsewhere; script always uses the listener.

a11y: The scroller is a focusable region named by label: the arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down and Home and End scroll it a picture at a time (scroll-snap), and the focus ring shows only for keyboard focus. The pictures are a list with their own alt text, in order.
Reduced motion: no transform is linked to the scroll position and nothing turns by itself. The ring is replaced by a flat strip of the same pictures that scrolls natively, in the same named region.
Without CSS scroll timelines a scroll listener sets the same rotation; the keyboard behaviour does not change.
Right to left: the scroller starts at the inline start, and the rotation follows the distance scrolled.
